cells.gaps: No source from the last three years says a consultation on a digital law or policy was held because a law, decree or published procedure required it. ESCCOM notice 7/2025 calls its consultation one contemplated by section 32 of its Act, which does not say the Act requires it.
cells.note: ESCCOM's June 2025 decision on retiring 2G and 3G summarises the comments it received and answers them, a yes to question 2. No consultation has been found under a rule requiring it.
